description: Add cetirizine 10 mg daily for seasonal allergies
presentation: Patient is a 28 year old man who has urinary frequency despite treatment for a presumed UTI. Patient has nocturia and workup for polyuria was done. He takes cetirizine 10 mg daily for seasonal allergies. CMP and A1c were normal but urine sodium and urine osm were both low. What further workup should be done to work up diabetes insipidus or other etiologies?
